name: parakeet-unified base model + GPU-PB biasing on clean_eval_v2
short_description: Per-clip STT predictions from the pretrained parakeet-unified-en-0.6b base model with malsd_batch decoding and GPU-PB context biasing, evaluated on the 91-clip clean_eval_v2 holdout as Arm B of the biasing x fine-tuning 2x2 ablation.
model_description: nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b, HuggingFace pretrained checkpoint, no local model asset. Decoding uses malsd_batch with a GPU-PB boosting tree (context_score=3.0, depth_scaling=0.5, alpha=1.5).
prediction_schema: Each line is a JSON object with fields: clip_id (string), ref (string, ground-truth transcript), hyp (string, model hypothesis), brand (string "Rezolve"/"brainpowa" or null for neutral clips), label (string "EXACT"/"PHONETIC"/"GARBAGE" brand-match category or null for neutral clips), wer (float, per-clip word error rate), latency_seconds (float, per-clip inference latency), source (string "quepasa_prod" or "clean_eval_21" provenance tag).

files.description: Per-clip predictions (91 rows) for Arm B (base model + GPU-PB biasing) on the clean_eval_v2 holdout: reference/hypothesis text, brand label, per-clip WER, and latency.
